actions.text: Committee on Veterans' Affairs. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
Committee on Veterans' Affairs. Hearings held. Hearings printed: S.Hrg. 119-247.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Veterans' Affairs.

dimensions.assessment: Affects covered veterans residing within 35 miles of a critical access hospital or affiliated rural health clinic, as well as those facilities and third party administrators.
dimensions.evidence: the veteran resides within 35 miles of such hospital or clinic.

dimensions.assessment: Modifies prior authorization requirements and establishes Medicare-equivalent cost-based reimbursement rates for qualifying veteran care.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary may not require a covered veteran to receive authorization or a referral prior to the receipt of care

dimensions.assessment: Shifts payment rates to Medicare critical access hospital rates and cost-based reimbursement levels for specific community care claims.
dimensions.evidence: shall be reimbursed at the cost-based level under the Medicare program.

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 38 to add new provisions for care eligibility, payment rules, claims processing timelines, and reporting requirements.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title 38, United States Code, to expand access by veterans to critical access hospitals

dimensions.assessment: Establishes permanent statutory changes to the Veterans Community Care Program alongside a one-time report deadline.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than one year after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Secretary of Veterans Affairs shall submit to Congress a report

missing_information: Exact count of veterans who live within 35 miles of eligible critical access hospitals.
Total projected federal spending changes resulting from cost-based reimbursement.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill expands veteran healthcare access under the Veterans Community Care Program for certain veterans living near critical access hospitals or rural health clinics, changes reimbursement rates, and requires a report, affecting veterans in specific rural areas and participating medical facilities.
